Claude Skills, explained. For a small shop.
Priya runs a sweet shop. Her orders come on WhatsApp, and in the counter book.
Every evening, she reads each order and types it into her billing app.
Forty orders a day. Three minutes each. Two hours, every evening.
One year later, that's six hundred hours. And a few wrong quantities that cost her money.
Now meet a second Priya. She teaches Claude how her shop works. Just once.
So, what does she teach it?
Three things. Her price list and nicknames. K K means kaju katli. Her regular customers. And three real orders, with the right bill for each.
Her billing app keeps the books. Claude does the reading.
Now she drops in the day's WhatsApp screenshots, and a photo of the counter book. Claude returns a clean sheet to import, and flags two unclear orders.
To be fair, she still checks every line. Claude doesn't replace her billing app. It feeds it.
To make one: in Claude's settings, turn on skill creator. Describe your orders in a chat. Upload the Skill it makes, and test it.
Your software needs clean data. Teach Claude to make it clean.
